batches.name: Bethel Park, Whitehall and Bridgeville
batches.why: Two merged South Hills parishes (2020/2021), one diocesan page each. Leads: ParishesOnline 14/1251 (our-lady-of-hope-parish-15102) and 14/0673 (corpus-christi-parish-15017); org st-barbara-parish-15017 and st-germaine are older orgs, check they are not live channels. Typical first batch.

batches.name: Butler city and Center Township
batches.why: All Saints Parish (2021 merger), five churches on one diocesan page. Lead: ParishesOnline 14/1322 (all-saints-parish-st-andrew-...). GCatholic adds St. Stanislaus Kostka, Lyndora (Former Church, 'closed 2020.07.01') and the predecessor churches' old names.

batches.name: Chicora, Cabot, Herman and Carbon Center
batches.why: Saints Francis and Clare Parish was established 2026 (diopitt archives Facebook post) from St. Clare of Assisi and St. Francis of Assisi parishes; the Mass Finder still uses the old names and both old websites (saintclareparish.com, saintfrancisparish.net) may still post bulletins. Lead: John Patrick Publishing church-bulletin.org/saints-francis-clare-parish-chicora-pa-16025 (issues 2026-06-14 and 2026-08-09 seen in search). Check whether the two predecessor bulletins stopped. GCatholic St. Patrick, Cowansville (Former Church, Armstrong County) is here by distance only.

batches.name: Slippery Rock, Prospect and West Sunbury
batches.why: St. Faustina Parish: four churches plus the Slippery Rock University Newman Center (Sunday 7 p.m. in term, per the diocesan page): a campus worship site, see proposed campus rule. GCatholic Epiphany, Boyers and St. Alphonsus, Murrinsville are predecessor churches (St. Alphonsus parish -> St. Faustina).

batches.name: Cranberry, Glade Mills, Zelienople and Ellwood City
batches.why: Two Cranberry-area parishes. Leads: ParishesOnline 14/1775 (saint-mark-the-evangelist-parish) and 14/1741 (divine-grace-parish-16066). Divine Grace's page lists two churches; the Mass Finder adds Holy Redeemer, Ellwood City, which the predecessor list also puts in Divine Grace: settle whether it still has Mass. GCatholic St. Matthias, Evans City is assigned here by distance.

batches.name: New Castle and Lawrence County
batches.why: Holy Spirit Parish of Lawrence County (seven Lawrence County parishes merged about 2019 per ncnewsonline.com; Holy Redeemer, Ellwood City went to Divine Grace in 2022). Lead: ParishesOnline 14/1181. GCatholic still lists many predecessor churches (St. Joseph the Worker, St. Vincent de Paul, St. James Pulaski, St. Lawrence Hillsville, St. Anthony Bessemer): settle each from the bulletin. LPi also has old New Castle orgs (st-vitus-church-16101, st-marys-church, holy-trinity-church-16102...).

batches.name: Beaver, Rochester, New Brighton, Freedom and Beaver Falls
batches.why: Two Beaver County merged parishes. Leads: ParishesOnline 14/1276 (our-lady-of-the-valley-parish-15009); St. Augustine Parish formed 2023-01-02 from St. Blaise and St. Monica (diopitt news). GCatholic St. Monica, Darlington and St. Joseph, New Brighton may be former churches or the same building under an old name.

batches.name: Aliquippa, Monaca, Ambridge and Franklin Park
batches.why: Mary, Queen of Saints (2021, four churches) and St. Luke the Evangelist (two churches). GCatholic St. John the Baptist, Baden and Our Lady of Peace, Conway are predecessor parishes of St. Luke per the diocese's predecessor list.

batches.name: Sewickley, Coraopolis, Moon and Crescent
batches.why: Two Ohio River parishes, two and three churches. Most Sacred Heart's administrator is also part-time chaplain to Robert Morris University (campus Mass, if any, is not on any roster).

batches.name: McKees Rocks, Kennedy, Robinson, Crafton and Ingram
batches.why: Archangel Gabriel (two churches on the diocesan page, three on the Mass Finder: Holy Trinity, Robinson is listed only by the finder and GCatholic) and St. Philip (Crafton/Ingram; ParishesOnline 14/1356, org st-philip-catholic-parish; older org st-philip-church-15205). GCatholic Mother of Sorrows, Holy Innocents and St. Martin are predecessor churches.

batches.name: Bellevue, Emsworth, Franklin Park, West View, Ross and Perrysville
batches.why: Two North Boroughs parishes. The diocese's parish page lists Incarnation of the Lord (Perry North) with 'No Masses Scheduled'; settle each from the bulletin (worship site, occasional Mass, or excluded closed).

batches.name: Wexford, Hampton and Richland
batches.why: Two two-church North Hills parishes. Sts. Martha and Mary's website is smmpgh.org (predecessor list: stsmarthaandmaryparish.org).

batches.name: Glenshaw, Allison Park, Etna, Millvale and Reserve
batches.why: St. Matthew (four churches; ParishesOnline 14/1151; old org holy-spirit-15209) and Our Lady of Perpetual Help (two churches, 2021 merger). Both have a church in Glenshaw.

batches.name: Sharpsburg, Aspinwall, Blawnox and O'Hara
batches.why: Christ the King Parish (2021 merger), six churches, one with a Korean Mass. The diocese's parish page lists Madonna of Jerusalem (Sharpsburg) with 'No Masses Scheduled'; settle each from the bulletin (worship site, occasional Mass, or excluded closed). GCatholic's St. Pio of Pietrelcina (24374, 'merged to Christ the King 2021') sits 0.1 km from St. Edward, Blawnox: probably the same building under its former parish name.

batches.name: Natrona Heights, Harwick, Tarentum, Russellton and Bairdford
batches.why: Guardian Angels (two churches on the diocesan page; GCatholic has eight entries, e.g. St. Clement and Sts. Peter and Paul, Tarentum, Holy Family, Creighton, St. Alphonsus, Springdale: settle each) and Our Lady of the Lakes (two churches).

batches.name: Oakmont, Plum, Verona, Monroeville and Penn Hills
batches.why: Holy Family (four churches; ParishesOnline 14/1224, org holy-family-parish-opv) and Christ the Divine Shepherd (two churches; eCatholic site 21574 posts files.ecatholic.com/21574/bulletins/20261025.pdf; its LPi org is empty). GCatholic North American Martyrs, St. Bartholomew, St. Gerard Majella and St. Januarius are predecessor churches.

batches.name: North Side and Brighton Heights
batches.why: Christ Our Savior (three churches) and Most Precious Blood of Jesus, the personal parish of the Institute of Christ the King (Latin Mass; mostpreciousbloodparish.org redirects to institute-christ-king.org/pittsburgh-home). Watch out: LPi org most-precious-blood-of-jesus-parish resolves to container 14/1701, the same container as christ-our-savior-parish-15212: read the masthead before giving that id to either row.

batches.name: Shrines of Pittsburgh: Troy Hill, Polish Hill, Millvale and the Strip
batches.why: One diocesan page and one team for four canonical parishes (Immaculate Heart of Mary, Most Holy Name of Jesus, St. Nicholas, St. Patrick-St. Stanislaus Kostka; the predecessor list says 'In Grouping 114'). Six worship sites including St. Anthony Chapel (shrine, Sunday 11:30) and St. Patrick, Strip ('Sunday Masses at Saint Stanislaus Church'). Lead: ParishesOnline 14/1226 (orgs shrines-of-pittsburgh and st-patrick-st-stanislaus-kostka-parish). Check whether any member still prints its own.

batches.name: Downtown, Uptown, Oakland, Greenfield and Hazelwood
batches.why: Divine Mercy (ParishesOnline 14/1839; org divine-mercy-parish-15222 is empty) and St. Paul Cathedral (14/1180). The diocese's parish page lists St. Stephen (Hazelwood) with 'No Masses Scheduled'; settle each from the bulletin (worship site, occasional Mass, or excluded closed). GCatholic St. Regis (Oakland) is a predecessor parish.

batches.name: Lawrenceville, Bloomfield, Shadyside and Morningside
batches.why: St. Pio of Pietrelcina (formed 2024-01-01 from Our Lady of the Angels and St. Maria Goretti; diopitt history page: 'St. Augustine Church remained open to serve the new parish'; ParishesOnline 14/0730, also under org st-maria-goretti-parish) and St. Jude (two churches). GCatholic lists St. Maria Goretti three times (24336-24338): find which buildings they are.

batches.name: Point Breeze, Wilkinsburg, Homewood and the Hill District
batches.why: St. Mary Magdalene (LPi org saint-mary-magdalene-parish is empty) and St. Benedict the Moor (personal parish for Black Catholics; its LPi org st-benedict-the-moor-church-15219 is empty). The diocese's parish page lists Mother of Good Counsel (Brushton) with 'No Masses Scheduled'; settle each from the bulletin (worship site, occasional Mass, or excluded closed). GCatholic Holy Rosary (Homewood) belonged to St. Charles Lwanga, now St. Mary Magdalene.

batches.name: South Side, Mount Washington, Carrick, Brentwood and Hays
batches.why: Mary, Queen of Peace (lead: ParishesOnline 14/0020 under two orgs named for Prince of Peace and St. Mary of the Mount) and Blessed Trinity (four churches; LPi org blessed-trinity-parish-15227 empty, old orgs for St. Albert, St. Basil, St. Wendelin, Holy Angels exist). GCatholic St. Peter (South Side, merged 1992), St. John Vianney, St. Norbert, St. Wendelin are old churches; the Passionist monastery is in the institutions batch.

batches.name: Beechview, Brookline, Castle Shannon and Mount Lebanon
batches.why: St. Teresa of Kolkata (eCatholic site 21158 posts files.ecatholic.com/21158/bulletins/20261025.pdf; LPi org empty; Mass in Spanish likely) and St. Paul of the Cross (ParishesOnline 14/1799, newest issue 2026-10-18 when probed 2026-10-23; St. Winifred is called a chapel). GCatholic Our Lady of Loreto and St. Pamphilus are predecessor churches.

batches.name: Carnegie, Green Tree, Scott and Mount Lebanon
batches.why: St. Raphael the Archangel (three churches) and St. Michael the Archangel (two churches; ParishesOnline 14/1161, org st-michael-the-archangel1-parish).

batches.name: Upper St. Clair, Bethel Park, South Park, Peters and Finleyville
batches.why: Three South Hills parishes with two churches each. The diocese's parish page lists St. Joan of Arc (South Park) with 'No Masses Scheduled'; settle each from the bulletin (worship site, occasional Mass, or excluded closed). GCatholic St. Isaac Jogues (Jefferson Hills) is a predecessor of St. John XXIII.

batches.name: Clairton, Jefferson Hills, Pleasant Hills, Elizabeth, Glassport and Liberty
batches.why: Triumph of the Holy Cross (ParishesOnline 14/1225) and Sts. Joachim and Anne (14/0524, org sts-joachim-and-ann-parish; old org queen-of-the-rosary-parish). GCatholic Holy Spirit (West Mifflin) is a predecessor of Triumph; St. David and St. Joseph (McKeesport) are assigned here by distance only.

batches.name: West Mifflin, Homestead, Munhall and Duquesne
batches.why: St. Thomas the Apostle (2020 merger), six churches on the diocesan page. Lead: ParishesOnline 14/0675; old org christ-the-light-of-the-world-st-joseph-st-agnes-holy-trinity-parishes. The diocese's parish page lists St. Joseph (Duquesne) and St. Rita (Munhall) with 'No Masses Scheduled'; settle each from the bulletin (worship site, occasional Mass, or excluded closed). GCatholic Holy Name and St. Hedwig (Duquesne), Resurrection (West Mifflin) are older churches.

batches.name: McKeesport, White Oak, Forest Hills, Braddock, Swissvale and Turtle Creek
batches.why: Mary, Mother of God (ParishesOnline 14/0560 under org corpus-christi-parish-15132) and St. Joseph the Worker (14/1182; only one church on the diocesan page, while GCatholic has eleven entries near it: Good Shepherd, St. Colman, St. Jude, St. Maurice, St. John Fisher, St. Barnabas, St. Anselm, Madonna del Castello, Sacred Heart (Braddock Hills), and St. Helen and St. William (East Pittsburgh, by distance only); settle each). The diocese's parish page lists Corpus Christi (McKeesport) with 'No Masses Scheduled'; settle each from the bulletin (worship site, occasional Mass, or excluded closed).

batches.name: Washington, Bentleyville, Richeyville and California
batches.why: One pastor (Rev. Edward L. Yuhas, both diocesan pages) and one website (catholicpartnerparishes.org, eCatholic 20435) for both parishes; the 25 Oct 2026 issue at files.ecatholic.com/20435/bulletins/20261025.pdf has the masthead 'Catholic Partner Parishes / Saint James Parish & Saint Katharine Drexel Parish'. Campus Masses: W&J College Newman Center and California University of PA (in term only). The diocese's parish page lists Sacred Heart (Claysville) with 'No Masses Scheduled'; settle each from the bulletin (worship site, occasional Mass, or excluded closed). GCatholic still lists St. Thomas Aquinas (California), St. Joseph (Roscoe), St. Michael (Fredericktown), Sts. Mary and Ann (Marianna).

batches.name: McDonald, Burgettstown, Imperial, Avella and Oakdale
batches.why: St. Isidore the Farmer (2020 merger), six churches. The diocese's parish page lists St. Ann (Bulger) with 'No Masses Scheduled'; settle each from the bulletin (worship site, occasional Mass, or excluded closed).

batches.name: Canonsburg, Meadow Lands, Muse, Charleroi, Donora and Monongahela
batches.why: Two Washington County parishes, three churches each; Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal has a Spanish Mass. Not linked; batched by county.

batches.name: Greene County
batches.why: St. Matthias (four churches; eCatholic site 23303 posts files.ecatholic.com/23303/bulletins/20261025.pdf). GCatholic still lists St. Thomas (Clarksville), Our Lady of Consolation (Nemacolin), St. Mary (Crucible) and Sacred Heart (Rices Landing). Waynesburg University campus ministry is not on any roster.

batches.name: Oratory, seminary, monastery and diocesan programme entries
batches.why: Places that are not parish churches: the Pittsburgh Oratory (St. Philip Neri, Oakland; serves Pitt and CMU Catholic campus ministry), St. Paul Seminary, St. Paul of the Cross Monastery (Passionists, South Side Slopes), and two Mass Finder entries with no address that look like programmes, not worship sites (FEST Pittsburgh, festpgh.org; Pittsburgh Central Deanery, centraldeanerypgh.org). Also check the off-roster campus chapels: Duquesne University Chapel of the Holy Spirit, CMU, Robert Morris, Waynesburg. Apply the orchestrator's campus/oratory rule.

batches.name: Byzantine Catholic (Ruthenian) churches in the territory
batches.why: GCatholic lists 27 Ruthenian-rite entries in this territory (the Byzantine Catholic Metropolitan Archeparchy of Pittsburgh is GCatholic pitt0), including its seminary (40410) and Holy Trinity Monastery, Butler (42050): other-jurisdiction exclusions. Confirm the 'Jurisdiction:' line on each GCatholic page.

batches.name: Ukrainian, Maronite, Romanian and Syro-Malabar churches
batches.why: GCatholic entries with rite Ukrainian (9, one a Former Church 'closed 2013'), Maronite (3), Romanian (1) and Syro-Malabar (1, a mission): other-jurisdiction exclusions. Quote the eparchy from each GCatholic page's 'Jurisdiction:' line rather than assuming it.
